analyst.summary: Viyash Scientific (until January 2026, Sequent Scientific) is a veterinary/animal-health pharmaceutical company making active ingredients and finished formulations for cattle and poultry, recently combined with Viyash Life Sciences in a court-approved merger. The company has just turned around from a loss-making period into strong profit growth, and management is guiding to steady mid-teens growth with stable margins going forward, alongside a pending bolt-on acquisition in Italy. Because of the recent merger, however, the reported year-on-year growth and profitability figures are affected by how the combined entity compares to its pre-merger base, so they should be read with some caution rather than taken as a clean trend. We rate it a Hold: a real turnaround story in a consolidating global animal-health business, but one where the reported numbers need to be understood through the lens of the recent merger before being fully trusted.
